Geoff North running for the first time in Belgrave colours on the Brighton road faced a tough task against strong opposition but with a good run he caught Surrey AC and Ealing; although having to give way to "Kipper" Herring of Blackheath.

In a hard tussle with "Kipper" Herring of Blackheath he clocked 27:41---47secs behind Herring, but nearly 2 minutes ahead of the 3rd man. Tony Fairclough has laid claim to a Club Honours badge by his performance in the Bracknell "10".
